facts.fact: Carson 在暴风雨来临时检查设备棚的锁、确认屋顶没漏水，并曾付钱给 Earl 和另一名牧场工人在树枝砸穿墙板后更换了一段侧板。
facts.anchor: once paid Earl and another ranch hand to replace a section of siding after a tree branch punched through it during a summer storm

facts.fact: Pops 亲手制作了收获节招牌，Carson 十几岁时就帮他一起做。
facts.anchor: Pops had made it himself, and I had helped him when I was barely a teen

facts.fact: Pops 去世约两年后，Carson 为发工资卖掉了第二台拖拉机，与自己争论了三天才在网上挂牌，24 小时内就卖出，Meme 在买家装车时哭了。
facts.anchor: spent three days arguing with myself before listing it online. It sold within twenty-four hours. Meme cried when the buyer loaded it onto a trailer

facts.fact: Pops 以每张五十分出售苹果酒票，尽管 Rosie 指出已经没人带零钱了。
facts.anchor: Pops sold cider tickets for fifty cents each, even after Rosie pointed out nobody carried quarters anymore

facts.fact: Carson 那天晚上一直醒到凌晨快一点，Meme 最后去睡了，他却无法平复心情。
facts.anchor: I stayed awake until almost one in the morning. Meme eventually went to bed

facts.fact: Pops 从八月就开始筹划收获节，Meme 抱怨他在夏天结束前就谈论它、毁了秋天。
facts.anchor: Pops started planning in August. Meme complained that he ruined fall by talking about it before summer ended

facts.fact: Beau 在检查拖拉机时拆下了电池，并发现燃油管开裂。
facts.anchor: Beau had removed the battery, found cracked fuel lines

facts.fact: Beau 看了手表，时间是 12:48，他们在设备棚里已经待了将近三个小时，Carson 却完全没察觉。
facts.anchor: 12:48. We had been in the equipment barn nearly three hours
